claim: AWS Network Firewall supports native integration with AWS Transit Gateway: a firewall owner can attach a Network Firewall directly to a transit gateway as a transit gateway attachment, with no additional charges beyond standard Network Firewall and Transit Gateway pricing; the What's New post of Jun 16, 2025 announced it in 5 AWS Regions.

qualifiers.condition: Region availability at launch was 5 AWS Regions; no saved page gives today's Region list

evidence.quote: Firewall owners can attach a Network Firewall directly to a transit gateway as a transit gateway attachment either within their own account or shared from a different account.

evidence.heading: AWS Network Firewall now supports AWS Transit Gateway native integration

evidence.quote: AWS Network Firewall now supports native integration with AWS Transit Gateway for simplified deployment and management of network security across your global AWS infrastructure. This capability is available in 5 AWS Regions, allowing customers to implement security controls more efficiently.
There are no additional charges for this native integration beyond standard pricing of AWS Network Firewall and AWS Transit Gateway.
